name: S Mei! ~Koakuma na Meikko~
original_name: えすめい!～小悪魔な姪っ子～
source:
When the virgin protagonists brother and sister-in-law go overseas for a business trip, they task him to watch his young niece, Kana.

As they spend time together under the same roof, Kana's true personality unfolds and the protagonist falls victim to her domineering ways. The happy days continue as he becomes her new toy.
